note.zh: Claude Opus 5（xhigh 思考档位）在 Claude Code 2.1.219 中用仓库标准中文提示词（仅按案例规则填写文末【本次运行】占位符）一次生成的圈地智能体，未经人工修改，耗时 70 分 40 秒。裸 harness 运行：全部 skills、plugins、MCP 与外部设置源均已禁用，工具只保留 Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep；模型未运行策略、未打对局。按案例规则策略文件不公开、仅注册运行，由维护者亲自执行，任何 bug 均不修复；产出文件仅按模型 id 重命名，内容逐字节未改。自命名「画地为牢」。策略为矩形圈地规划器，配合精确洪水填充的圈地收益评估、在线对手激进度建模、猎杀轨迹与安全不变量。独立 Arena 诊断判定 API 合规；对 baseline-expander 的两个固定诊断种子均告胜（1330:251、1504:86），全程仅 76 与 75 次圈地——与本模型 Max 档条目形成对照：那一档圈了 383/430 次却两局皆负，说明本题的胜负取决于每次圈地的质量而非次数。
note.en: One-shot Turf War agent by Claude Opus 5 (xhigh effort) in Claude Code 2.1.219 from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt (only the [This run] placeholders filled per case rules), with no human edits, 70 minutes 40 seconds. Run on a bare harness: all skills, plugins, MCP servers and external setting sources disabled, tools limited to Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep; the model never executed the policy or played a match. Per case rules the policy file is unpublished and no bug is ever fixed; this registers the maintainer-executed run. The produced file was only renamed to the model id, byte-identical otherwise. It named itself "画地为牢". The policy is a rectangular loop planner with exact flood-fill capture evaluation, online opponent-aggression modelling, trail hunting and safety invariants. Independent Arena diagnosis found the policy API-compliant; it won both fixed diagnostic seeds against baseline-expander (1330:251 and 1504:86) using only 76 and 75 captures — a contrast with this model's Max entry, which made 383 and 430 captures yet lost both seeds, showing that this case rewards the quality of each capture rather than their count.

note.zh: 在 Claude Code 2.1.219 中以 Claude Opus 5（xhigh 思考档位）一次生成的完整 Vite + React 18 + three.js 工程，未经修改，耗时 88 分 2 秒；本页为其构建产物（部署时由源码打包为单文件）。裸 harness 运行：全部 skills、plugins、MCP 与外部设置源均已禁用，工具只保留 Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep，沙箱内无外网。与同批 Max、High 两档的一处差异：模型把工程建在工作区的 dust2-fps 子目录而非根目录，测评 runner 在规范路径上未找到产物、因而把该次运行记为失败；此处按仓库的 React 工程目录约定原样收录该目录，未改动模型写出的任何内容。src 下 34 个文件，零外部美术资源。模型自建了 tools/ 下的离线校验套件，含依赖打桩（mock）、导入检查、导航网格检查与调试、渲染检查、规则检查与模拟对局。
note.en: A complete Vite + React 18 + three.js project generated in one shot by Claude Opus 5 (xhigh effort) in Claude Code 2.1.219, unmodified, 88 minutes 2 seconds; this page is its build output (bundled from source into a single file at deploy time). Run on a bare harness: all skills, plugins, MCP servers and external setting sources disabled, tools limited to Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep, with no network inside the sandbox. One difference from this batch's Max and High runs: the model created the project in a dust2-fps subdirectory of the workspace rather than at its root, so the benchmark runner found no deliverable at the canonical path and recorded the run as failed; the directory is included here as-is under the repository's React project convention, with nothing the model wrote altered. 34 files under src, zero external art assets. The model built its own offline verification suite under tools/, including dependency mocks, import checks, navmesh checks and debugging, render checks, rules checks and match simulation.
